section: Science · Ch — Methodology of Teaching Science
subject: Science
stem: A constructivist science-lesson framework structures instruction into five sequential phases — first capturing students' interest and prior ideas, then letting them explore hands-on, followed by the teacher clarifying concepts, then students applying the concept to new situations, and finally assessing understanding. These five phases are:

options.option_text: Engage, Explore, Explain, Elaborate, Evaluate (the 5E Model)

explanation: The 5E Model (Engage-Explore-Explain-Elaborate-Evaluate), rooted in constructivism, lets students first grapple with phenomena hands-on (Explore) before the teacher formally names/clarifies the concept (Explain) — reversing the traditional 'tell-then-practice' sequence seen in Herbart's formal steps.
